title: tucano.logistics.shipment.ready_for_pickup
description: The data of a ShipmentReadyForPickup event: the label is stored and the parcels wait for the carrier in the fulfillment center. The time is the CloudEvent time; where the label is stored stays inside Logistics.

store.description: The slug of the store the fact belongs to (ADR 0031). Optional: a fact from before the stores has none.
